sāpō, sāpōnis m.

noun, third declension

Other words

  • sāpōnis quadrula — a bar of soap

    also used · modern · Traupman 38: bar of soap, sāpōnis quadrula

    “A little square of soap”; quadrula is post-classical (Solinus).

Examples

  • Sāpōnem cape.

    Take the soap.composed

See also sponge, cloth, liquid soap, shampoo, wash.
